title: 1 Chronicles 28
paragraphs: ¹ David assembled all the leaders of Israel in Jerusalem — the tribal commanders, the commanders of the divisions that served the king, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, the officials over all the king's property and livestock, the palace officials, the soldiers and warriors, every man of standing. ² King David rose to his feet and said, "Listen to me, my brothers and my people. I had my heart set on building a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD — a footstool for our God — and I made preparations for building it. ³ But God said to me, 'You shall not build a house for my name, because you have been a warrior and have shed blood.' ⁴ Yet the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me from my whole family to be king over Israel forever. He chose Judah as the leading tribe, and from Judah he chose my father's family, and from among my father's sons he was pleased to make me king over all Israel. ⁵ Of all my sons — for the LORD has given me many — he has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

⁶ "He said to me, 'Your son Solomon will build my house and my courts, for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father. ⁷ I will establish his kingdom forever, if he holds firmly to carrying out my commands and ordinances, as he does now.' ⁸ So in the sight of all Israel, the LORD's assembly, and in the hearing of our God: keep and seek out all the commands of the LORD your God, so that you may hold this good land and pass it on as an inheritance to your descendants forever. ⁹ And you, my son Solomon, know the God of your father and serve him with wholehearted devotion and a willing spirit, for the LORD searches every heart and understands every intention behind every thought. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you abandon him, he will reject you forever. ¹⁰ Consider carefully now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house as the sanctuary. Be strong and do the work."

¹¹ Then David gave Solomon the plans for the vestibule of the temple, its buildings, its storerooms, its upper rooms, its inner rooms, and the room for the mercy seat. ¹² He also gave him the plans for everything he had in mind for the courts of the house of the LORD, all the surrounding rooms, the treasuries of God's house, and the treasuries for the dedicated gifts. ¹³ He gave him instructions for the divisions of the priests and Levites, for all the work of serving in the house of the LORD, and for all the articles used in the service. ¹⁴ He specified the weight of gold for each gold article used in various kinds of service, the weight of silver for each silver article used in various kinds of service, ¹⁵ the weight of gold for the golden lampstands and their lamps, with the weight for each lampstand and its lamps; and the weight of silver for the silver lampstands, with the weight for each lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each.

¹⁶ He also specified the weight of gold for each table of consecrated bread, and the weight of silver for the silver tables; ¹⁷ the weight of pure gold for the forks, sprinkling bowls, and pitchers; the weight of gold for each gold dish and the weight of silver for each silver dish; ¹⁸ and the weight of refined gold for the altar of incense. He also gave David the plan for the golden chariot — the cherubim that spread their wings and shelter the ark of the covenant of the LORD. ¹⁹ "All this is in writing," said David, "because the hand of the LORD was on me, guiding me in all the details of the plan." ²⁰ David also said to his son Solomon, "Be strong and courageous, and do the work. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you or abandon you until all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished.

²¹ The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the service of God's house. Every willing and skilled person will serve with you in all the work, and the commanders and all the people will obey your every command."
